interpretation: The frozen-affine source-survival identity, direct realized-path gradients, one-step correction/survival boundary, causality contract and authoring-level cost accounting were independently checked under the exact card assumptions. This does not establish originality, scientific admission, selection, software correctness, RTX2080Ti feasibility, native-task benefit or semantic retention.

formal_object.rationale: S is d by m, A is d by d, k is d and v/e are m. Expanding the Delta update relative to post-decay D_i S_(i-1) gives W_i=beta_i k_i e_i^T. Frozen chronological propagation gives C_(i,h)=P_(i+h,i)W_i. Unit keys, beta in [0,1] and diagonal 0<=d_r<=1 make the declared ordinary factors non-expansive.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: F04 is applied only to one additive source under frozen later affine coefficients; C04 defines a finite-horizon amplitude-floor surrogate using training suffix transitions; H06 explicitly rejects semantic/query/likelihood conclusions from state-norm survival. Gate domains, zero-write admission and training-only suffix access are declared.

derivation.rationale: Rank-one norm cancellation, chronological trace recurrence, displayed direct gradients and the beta-domain correction/survival bound were independently recomputed. The internal Pk versus P^Tq versus global-singular counterexample is also correct and is scoped only to object distinctness.

assumptions.rationale: The exact identity freezes the later realized affine path; moving-surrogate autodiff is separated from full nonlinear counterfactual influence. beta/decay domains, amplitude target, scale-blind write admission, training-only suffix, semantic limitations and absent hardware/software evidence are explicit.

method_expression.rationale: The method keeps the ordinary inference update, samples source/horizon pairs only in training, propagates selected directions through actual ordered transitions and adds a hinge to causal CE. Complexity distinguishes streaming live vectors, naive autodiff storage and exhaustive tracing; no implementation or checkpoint algorithm is claimed.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: The distinguishing prediction is narrowly higher selected-source survival under later key overlap, not semantic retention. The card retains decisive falsifiers: unchanged native recall, damaged valid revision, equal-cost CE/delayed-QA/write-decay explanations, an equivalent prior regularizer or poor correlation with nonlinear influence.

closest_alternative.rationale: The card and source note correctly identify known source decomposition, explicit write-rate decay and delayed semantic supervision as strong alternatives. Verified here means the closest-work uncertainty is honestly represented; it does not clear originality. Immutable author-code/full-formula comparison remains a scientific-admission blocker.

survival_identity.rationale: For nonzero W_i and unit k_i, rank-one Frobenius factorization gives ||P W_i||_F^2/||W_i||_F^2=||P k_i||_2^2. beta_i and e_i cancel. The result is limited to one independent source contribution on the frozen realized path and is not aggregate state, nonlinear counterfactual influence, query visibility or semantic retention.

gradient_factors.rationale: For z_j=A_j z_(j-1), s=||z_(i+h)||^2, g_(i+h)=2z_(i+h), g_(j-1)=A_j^T g_j and ds/dA_j=g_j z_(j-1)^T are correct. For j=i+1,...,i+h the displayed beta and diagonal-gate derivatives have the correct factors; the active hinge derivative is -2(rho_h^2-s). Normalization removes direct source beta_i/e_i derivatives while retaining z_i=k_i and later-coefficient gradients.

frozen_vs_moving_path.rationale: The card separates the frozen realized-path identity, autodiff of the declared moving surrogate through A_j(theta), and the unavailable full counterfactual influence when an earlier edit changes later features/coefficients. No global nonlinear retention theorem is claimed.

correction_survival_bound.rationale: For D=I and unit x/k, expansion yields 1-beta(2-beta)c^2. On beta in [0,1], residual ratio <=epsilon requires beta>=1-epsilon and maximal compatible source survival is 1-(1-epsilon^2)c^2. Exact correction at c=1 erases that direction. This is a one-step feasibility boundary, not a simultaneous guarantee.

target_and_zero_write_convention.rationale: rho_h is a norm-amplitude floor in [0,1], so rho_h^2 matches squared survival. A disclosed tau_write admission convention makes zero/tiny-write handling defined. Scale blindness across admitted writes remains an explicit proxy limitation.

object_distinctness.rationale: D07 measures Pk_i, D03 measures P^Tq and D06 measures global singular/log-volume behavior. The card's diagonal counterexample distinguishes these internal mathematical objects but does not establish external originality.

causality_and_information.rationale: Observed teacher-forced suffix transitions form training supervision only. Inference uses the unchanged Delta update and receives no suffix, answer, evaluator label, extra recurrent state or operator. Any future label-dependent sampling policy would need separate disclosure and review.

complexity.rationale: One trace transition is O(d); N sampled traces through H steps cost O(NHd), and exhaustive T-source tracing costs O(THd). Streaming forward holds O(Nd) current vectors; naive autodiff stores O(NHd), and exhaustive storage can reach O(THd). Checkpoint/custom reverse are unimplemented memory-time tradeoffs. Inference adds no state or computation.

closest_work_and_scientific_scope.rationale: How Linear Attention Remembers already gives source decomposition; the Tabular ICL work gives explicit write-rate decay; Delayed Supervision is a stronger semantic alternative when labels exist. The author implementation is not immutably pinned and a full-formula search for an equivalent arbitrary-key survival loss is incomplete. The residual is a narrow candidate training use, not originality or necessity clearance.

unresolved_conditions: Pin and inspect the Tabular ICL author implementation and complete a full-formula collision audit for arbitrary-key ordered-write norm survival.
Matched long-horizon CE, delayed semantic supervision, simple write-rate decay and source-trace controls may explain any benefit at lower or equal cost.
The normalized loss is scale blind and may be gamed by key reorientation or conservative later gates; tau_write and sampling choices are not additional candidates.
Higher ||Pk_i|| can preserve obsolete or unreadable state, damage valid revision, or leave native delayed recall unchanged.
The frozen affine trace may poorly approximate full nonlinear influence when earlier edits change later features.
No inspected native scorer certifies the internal trace or revision validity; software, numerical, hardware and empirical acceptance remain outside this review.
